title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook 2-1/2-Inch Extendable | Retractable Hooks And Garment Rods | Allied Brass
description:
Need hanging space in your bathroom without a hook sticking out all the time? This modern retractable wall hook extends when you need it, then pushes back in to stay out of the way when not in use.

Highlights:
- Keep towels, robes, and clothing within reach—extendable rod creates 2-1/2 inches of hanging space
- Reduce bumps in tight bathrooms—retracts back into the wall when not in use
- Secure everyday storage—rated to hold up to 15 pounds
- Match your bathroom hardware—part of the Retractable Hooks and Garment Rods collection and offered in many finish options
- Personalize the look—knob tip can be removed and replaced with your own cabinet knob

Specs & Installation:
- Hanging extension: 2-1/2 inches
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 2 x 2 x 3.75 inches
- Weight capacity: up to 15 lb
- Wall type: fits standard interior walls
- Installation: requires drilling one 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes; installs with included toggle bolts and mounting hardware

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2'' of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room! Can hold up to 15 pounds Fits standard interior walls Installation does require drilling a 3/4'' dia. hole through drywall and 3 small holes around 2 1/2'' of hanging space All mounting hardware included Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 2x2x3.75 Box dimensions, in. (LxHxW): 12x10x4 Shipping weight, lbs: 1.3 Installation Instruction Technical Specification MD-22-Installation.pdf MD-22-Specification.pdf
